fullContentHtml:
MPPSC Food Safety Officer FSO Online Form 2025 – Full Details

Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC) has released the notification for the post of Food Safety Officer. This recruitment has been issued for 120 posts. Online applying process for MPPSC Food Safety Officer FSO Recruitment 2025 has started from 28 March 2025 & the candidates can apply till 27 April 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for MPPSC Food Safety Officer FSO Recruitment 2025 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 28 March 2025
  • Last Date : 27 April 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 27 April 2025
  • Last Date Correction : 29 April 2025
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 540/-
  • MP Reserve Category : Rs. 290/-
  • Portal Charges : Rs. 40/- (Included)
  • Correction Charges : Rs. 50/- (Extra)

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website
